## Description

GROWTH_MEASUREMENT: weight, length or height and head circumference with date, from nurse intake or the chart. Centiles and z-scores for weight-for-age, length/height-for-age and BMI-for-age from 0 to 5 years by sex use the WHO LMS tables. The chart draws the 3rd, 15th, 50th, 85th and 97th lines with the child's points, states the centile in words and flags a crossing of two major centile lines or a fall below the 3rd. Weight velocity is shown between the last two weights.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The z-score calculation reproduces WHO's published examples to two decimals (test).
- [ ] **AC2.** The growth chart has a text alternative stating the latest centile and the trend.
- [ ] **AC3.** A child over 5 years shows the measurements without centiles and says why.
- [ ] **AC4.** shortcut: 0–5 y WHO only; IAP 2015 (5–18 y, India) and UAE national charts when the clinical reviewer chooses them. The tables wait for clinical sign-off.

## Definition of Done
